title: P2 Inspector: retain and investigate frontend timeout observations
body: Parallel frontend execution reported six 5000ms timeouts. Targeted RAIT and dashboard reruns passed with unchanged assertions and timeouts, under reduced concurrency. This is an environment-sensitive observation, not an established product regression. Acceptance: repeatable controlled reproduction or a documented resource/concurrency remedy; no test weakening.
